tauri_event:tauri://resize.note: The window's size, place, scale or theme changed.

tauri_event:tauri://move.note: The window's size, place, scale or theme changed.

tauri_event:tauri://close-requested.note: The window asks to close: the quit hand-shake.

tauri_event:tauri://focus.item: tauri://focus and tauri://blur reach the UI through Platform.app, for polling only while focused.

tauri_event:tauri://blur.item: tauri://focus and tauri://blur reach the UI through Platform.app, for polling only while focused.

tauri_event:tauri://scale-change.note: The window's size, place, scale or theme changed.

tauri_event:tauri://theme-changed.note: The window's size, place, scale or theme changed.

tauri_event:rpc_from_sidecar.item: rpc_from_sidecar event delivers sidecar lines to the UI.

tauri_event:pty-ready.item: pty-ready event tells the UI a terminal is ready; ours returns from the spawn call instead.

tauri_event:pty-data.item: pty-data event delivers terminal output to the UI.

tauri_event:pty-exit.item: pty-exit event tells the UI a terminal process ended.

tauri_event:remote-file-sync-direct-info.note: CLOUD-11's sync runs over the Worker's file routes through the Host interface, which D018 put in place of Conductor's native file-sync commands and events.

tauri_event:remote-file-sync-status.note: CLOUD-11's sync runs over the Worker's file routes through the Host interface, which D018 put in place of Conductor's native file-sync commands and events.

tauri_event:agent_binary_progress.item: agent_binary_progress event reports download progress of an agent program.

tauri_event:port-forward-token-request.item: port-forward-token-request asks for a forward token.

tauri_event:deep-link://new-url.note: The OS hands a conducted:// link to the app.

tauri_event:binary_verification_errors.item: binary_verification_errors event reports agent programs that failed verification.

tauri_event:open_settings_page.item: open_settings_page opens the settings page from the menu.

tauri_event:open_keyboard_shortcuts_dial.note: An app menu item sent to the UI.

tauri_event:open_feedback_dialog.note: An app menu item sent to the UI.

tauri_event:open_documentation_url.note: An app menu item sent to the UI.

tauri_event:open_best_practices_url.note: An app menu item sent to the UI.

tauri_event:open_changelog_url.note: An app menu item sent to the UI.

tauri_event:open_diagnostics_page.note: An app menu item sent to the UI.

tauri_event:open_submit_prompt_dialog.note: An app menu item sent to the UI.

tauri_event:toggle_left_sidebar.note: An app menu item sent to the UI.

tauri_event:toggle_right_sidebar.note: An app menu item sent to the UI.

tauri_event:manual_update_status.item: The updater://status event (Conductor names it manual_update_status) reports update download state.

tauri_event:notification-deep-link-click.note: A click on a native notification opens its link.

tauri_event:quit_requested.item: quit_requested event asks the UI to confirm quitting.

tauri_event:network-changed.item: network-changed event reports a network change.
